summary: ConnectM Technology Solutions filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of senior secured convertible notes and warrants to Ascent Partners Fund LLC, with gross proceeds up to $5,000,000. The first tranche closed at $200,000 (with an original issue discount), and a second tranche of $2,300,000 was expected by September 4, 2026. Notes bear 10% interest, mature August 2027, and convert automatically upon a listing event into Series C Preferred. Warrants are exercisable for five years. Collateral includes a first-priority lien on substantially all assets, including 160,000,000 Blue Cloud Softech shares. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
